1.consolidated_definition: Abonera. Consiste de sic un tanque para echar el abono. El tanque tiene unos orificios por donde sale el abono al surco.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Manure Spreader. Consists of a tank for pouring manure fertilizer. The tank has openings through which the fertilizer is released into the furrow.
